text:
Maya: Quick usability note from the session: the suppression preview row looks clickable. Users tried to open the kebab and got confused. Ravi: Seen that. Visual affordances (hover, underline) make it read like an active threshold. We should make preview rows non-interactive. Sophie: Agreed, but also need a keyboard-accessible summary. If we remove focusability we must surface the preview via an ARIA live region. Maya: Proposed UI: dashed row style + small left pill that says "Suppression preview". Ghost rows should have tabindex=-1. Ravi: Implementation tip: pointer-events:none for ghost row, and add a separate summary box with role=status and tabindex=-1 that we programmatically focus when preview toggles. Sophie: Accessibility checklist: 1) announce "Suppression preview active: mutes Slack, Email for 1 hour" via aria-live, 2) tab order skips ghost rows, 3) "+N more" expands an accessible popover for long channel lists. DesignBot: Generated snippet to paste into prototype:
Suppression preview active: mutes alerts to Slack, Email for 1 hour.
Maya: Copy question: backend calls it "Suppressed" but designers like "Muted". Suggest showing friendly label ("Muted until 2:00 PM") with a tooltip saying "Status: Suppressed" for parity. Ravi: Also note contrast: dashed stroke + 70% opacity might fail AA; let's run contrast and bump stroke if needed. Sophie: I'll write short a11y acceptance criteria and test steps. Ravi, can you confirm hexes after contrast check? Maya will check with PM on final copy. :thumbsup:
